description: Number of Terminals Handling Containerships with On-Dock Rail at the Top 25 Container Ports: 2023 is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Maritime and Waterways", published or maintained by U.S. DOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. These data describe on-dock intermodal transportation facilities. On-dock rail allows shipping containers to be transferred directly between a ship and a train within the marine terminal, bypassing the need for 'drayage' trucks to haul them to a separate rail yard. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Maritime and Waterways". It has 4 columns, among them Number of Terminals, On-Dock Rail Access, Port, State. The portal shows 2024-01-10 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. DOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
